turns.text: Another one or another really good phrase is, "I was wondering if this one is very friendly and relaxed.
turns.zh: 另一个，或者说另一个特别好用的说法是「I was wondering if」，这个说法非常友好、随意。

turns.text: It's like you're thinking out loud."
turns.zh: 就像你是在把心里想的说出来一样。

turns.text: You're saying, "I have this question in my mind.
turns.zh: 你是在说：「我脑子里有这个疑问。

turns.text: I was thinking about it." So, you're not just throwing the question at them.
turns.zh: 我一直在想这个事。」所以你不是直接把问题甩给对方。
你是在给对方一个心理准备。

turns.text: So, for example, you could say, "I was wondering if I could borrow your book." Or, "I was wondering if you have a minute to talk." It's a nice smooth way to start.
turns.zh: 所以，举个例子，你可以说：「I was wondering if I could borrow your book.」或者「I was wondering if you have a minute to talk.」这是一个很顺、很自然的开场方式。
